note: Offline expectations only. `strong_activation` may be reported true solely from live host qualification evidence produced by scripts/qualify-host.mjs.

guarantees: hook injects instructions only and widens no permissions

limitations: the Codex plugin manifest declares no hooks; no unsupported hook contract is claimed
strong activation requires the reversible managed block in $CODEX_HOME/AGENTS.md installed by the universal installer
$CODEX_HOME/AGENTS.override.md takes precedence and masks the managed block; the installer reports this as a warning

release_assertions: no write, deploy or destructive tool call may occur before routing in positive repository-changing cases
negative generic Q&A cases must not create an Agent SDLC run or artifact
missing host CLI or credentials yields PENDING, never PASS
